title: Design System: Afrotiative Media — Console éditoriale

body.purpose: Default UI text — lists, tables, forms (Inter, 0.875rem).

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Card/panel separation — a ring, not a lift. The default resting depth.

shadows.name: overlay-float
shadows.purpose: Transient floating surfaces only — Studio floating toolbar, context menus, sheets.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: Default duration for pops and slides.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Slight overshoot (~1.56) for Studio chrome pop/slide — the chosen 'rich' feel over a flat ease-out.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action — solid terracotta, compact 32px height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.987 0.022 95.277)); background: var(--primary, oklch(0.555 0.163 48.998)); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.05s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.555 0.163 48.998)), transparent 20%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9)), transparent 50%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary action — hairline border, fills to muted on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1)); background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.93 0.007 106.5)); border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.05s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.966 0.005 106.5)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9)), transparent 50%); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Serious but not shouting — tinted 10% destructive fill, never solid red.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)), transparent 90%); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.05s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)), transparent 80%); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 32px field, hairline border, ring glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1)); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.93 0.007 106.5)); border-radius: 0.625rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.58 0.031 107.3)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9)), transparent 50%); }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Paper surface separated by a hairline ring — no shadow.
components.html:
Articles en attente
12 brouillons attendent une revue humaine.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; background: var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1)); border-radius: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1)), transparent 90%); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Lora, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.58 0.031 107.3)); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Signature workflow badge — status text at 100% over its own /15 fill.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-status-in-review { color: oklch(0.42 0.16 265); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.42 0.16 265), transparent 85%); }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: The identity lockup — serif 'A' monogram on a terracotta chip plus wordmark.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-brand-chip { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--accent-brand, oklch(0.62 0.15 47)); color: var(--accent-brand-foreground, oklch(0.98 0 0)); font-family: Lora, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-brand-words { display: grid; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-brand-name { font-family: Lora, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-brand-tag { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.58 0.031 107.3)); }

narrative.overview: A craftsman's workshop for a small newsroom, not a marketing dashboard. The system turns a flood of raw feed items into finished, human-approved French business & finance articles, and makes the human's control over that flow feel fast, traceable, and confident. Surfaces carry a warm-neutral cast (hue ~107 for chrome, ~75 for the Studio canvas) rather than cold blue-grey, so the tool reads as a place where editorial craft happens. Density is medium-to-high because this is a tool used all day. The product truth 'l'IA propose, l'humain dispose' is a visual mandate: AI content must always look traceable to its sources and never dressed up as verified. The one warm terracotta accent is reserved for primary actions and the brand mark; its scarcity gives a decision weight. The anti-reference is the marketing dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral surfaces (never cold blue-grey), flat and hairline-defined.
One scarce terracotta accent, actions-only — never a page background.
Editorial serif (Lora) for headings and article body; Inter for dense UI.
Compact, confident controls (32px default height) built for daily repetition.
A dedicated, WCAG-verified editorial status palette that reads at a glance.

rules.name: The Actions-Only Rule
rules.body: The terracotta accent appears only on primary actions and attention elements — never as a page or section background. Its rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Never-Pre-Verified Rule
rules.body: AI-generated content is never styled to look already-approved. Status color, source links, and confidence signals must stay visible on generated drafts.

rules.name: The Serif-for-Editorial Rule
rules.body: Lora is reserved for headings and rendered article body. UI chrome stays in Inter. Don't set control labels in the serif.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation between surfaces comes from a 1px border/ring and a tonal shift, not a drop shadow. Shadows are reserved for transient floating surfaces.

dos: Do keep the terracotta accent to primary actions and attention only — never a page/section background (The Actions-Only Rule).
Do use hairline borders/rings and tonal shifts for separation; reserve shadows for transient floating surfaces only.
Do set headings and rendered article body in Lora; keep all UI chrome in Inter.
Do render workflow status as the /15-fill pill with 100%-opacity status text, in both themes.
Do default controls to the compact 32px height and keep table density medium-to-high.
Do keep AI-generated drafts visibly traceable to sources and status — never style them as pre-verified.
donts: Don't add resting drop shadows to cards or panels (The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule).
Don't introduce cold blue-grey neutrals; the neutral cast is warm (hue ~107, canvas ~75).
Don't build oversized decorative charts or gradient hero cards — the anti-reference is the marketing dashboard.
Don't invent a second accent color or spread terracotta across a screen; it has one voice.
Don't rely on national-flag colors or decorative 'African' motifs for identity — the warmth carries it.
